Overview.Name: Bonagiri Ramya
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & egg curry (2 eggs)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry
Evening_Snack: Option 3: Small fruit bowl (apple or orange)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & paneer cubes (60 g) + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals simple and consistent to reduce stress-related eating.
Start meals with egg, chicken or paneer before rice.
For boredom eating, drink water or buttermilk first before choosing food.
Keep dinner lighter with curd-based meals for better sleep and digestion.
Consistency will improve both mood and body composition over time.
